payload.text: AE's courseware uses two of Molt's output strings as an attendee's done-when test, so they are interface, not decoration. Doctor's final line is 'All checks passed.' (lib/molt.sh:2517, a bare echo with no prefix). Resleeve's final line PRINTS AS 'Zen: Sleeve ready. Welcome back.', not the bare string: molt_info goes through molt_log, which prefixes info with 'Zen:' (lib/molt.sh:17-32), so the literal at 2708 is not what a user sees. Both printed lines are pinned by the suite, by composition rather than by one assertion each: test/molt.bats:107 asserts doctor's whole output equals 'All checks passed.' exactly, which also proves it carries no prefix; test/molt.bats:987 asserts molt_info's format exactly as 'Zen: hello'; test/molt.bats:802 asserts the resleeve message as a substring. So a change to the prefix or to either message goes red before it ships, and the obligation is only to tell agentic-engineering-vc when such a change is deliberate, so its lines move in the same week instead of surprising an instructor mid-session. AE's affected lines for the resleeve string are chapters/T03-molt/deck-prose.md:48 and deck.md:85, which say it 'ends' with the bare string; exercises.md:61 and reference.md:32 use doctor's string correctly and were never wrong. Accepted by vc 9 Nov on AE's request; both referents were corrected from source by AE's ac and vc after vc recorded them. hv can overrule it.
